title: SpendWise — Application Overview
description: Health, transactions, AI parsing and sign-ins of the SpendWise API, from its OpenTelemetry metrics (docs/observability.md).

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: HTTP requests per second the API is answering (health probes excluded).

panels.title: Server errors (5xx)
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a 5xx status. No value means no traffic.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95% of requests finish within this time (rolling).

panels.title: Active requests
panels.description: Requests being processed right now.

panels.title: Requests by status class
panels.description: Requests per second, grouped as 2xx, 3xx, 4xx and 5xx.

panels.title: Request latency
panels.description: p50, p95 and p99 of the time the API takes to answer.

panels.title: Transactions saved
panels.description: Transactions created in the selected time range.

panels.title: Failed saves
panels.description: Attempts to create a transaction that failed (rejected input, database or internal errors).

panels.title: Save failure rate
panels.description: Failed saves as a share of all attempts in the selected range. No value means no attempts.

targets.expr:
100 * (sum(increase(spendwise_transaction_create_error_total{service_name="spendwise-api", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range])) or vector(0))
  / ((sum(increase(spendwise_transaction_created_total{service_name="spendwise-api", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(spendwise_transaction_create_error_total{service_name="spendwise-api", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) > 0)

panels.title: Transactions saved per minute
panels.description: By type (income or expense) and source (manual, or from an AI draft).

panels.title: Failed saves per minute
panels.description: By error type: validation (rejected input), database or internal.

panels.title: Parse requests
panels.description: Requests to the AI provider to turn text into a transaction draft, in the selected range.

panels.title: Parse failures
panels.description: AI parse requests that failed, in the selected range.

panels.title: Parse success rate
panels.description: Successful parses as a share of all parse requests in the selected range.

panels.title: p95 parse time
panels.description: 95% of AI parses (success or failure) finish within this time, over the selected range.

panels.title: Parse requests and failures per minute
panels.description: All parse requests, and failures by error type (provider or validation).

panels.title: AI parse duration
panels.description: p50 and p95 of the time the AI provider takes, successful and failed parses together.

panels.title: Refused sign-ins
panels.description: Sign-ins refused for an unknown email or a wrong password (never which), in the selected range.

panels.title: Refused sign-ins per minute
panels.description: A sudden rise can mean someone is guessing passwords.

panels.title: Running versions
panels.description: Environment and exact commit (service.version) of every API process that reported in the last minutes.

panels.title: Recent application logs
panels.description: SpendWise's own log records (Loki). Each one logged during a request links to its trace in Tempo.
